Case: Patient D is a 35-year-old Asian man who is post-op day 2 status-post left pterional craniotomy for clipping of an unruptured aneurysm. During your physical examination, you find expected post-operative swelling and tenderness of his left scalp tissues. The medical administration record shows that he has been needing 1 dose of hydrocodone every 6 hours for pain control.
Question: Would you offer a hydrocodone prescription to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – low (1 week) or high (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
